mapper.select: select q.* from ( select c.id, c.name, c.logo, c.cover, c.city, c.address, c.club_type as clubType, c.member_count as memberCount, case when c.location_lat is not null and c.location_lng is not null then 'address' else 'events' end as locationSource, coalesce(c.location_lat, ( select cast(a.latitude as decimal(12,7)) from cms_activity a where a.club_id = c.id and a.del_flag = 0 and a.status = 1 and a.publish_status = 1 and a.cancel_time is null and a.latitude regexp '^-?[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$' and a.longitude regexp '^-?[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$' order by a.start_date desc, a.id desc limit 1)) as lat, coalesce(c.location_lng, ( select cast(a.longitude as decimal(12,7)) from cms_activity a where a.club_id = c.id and a.del_flag = 0 and a.status = 1 and a.publish_status = 1 and a.cancel_time is null and a.latitude regexp '^-?[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$' and a.longitude regexp '^-?[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$' order by a.start_date desc, a.id desc limit 1)) as lng from club c where c.status = 1 and c.del_flag = 0 and (c.public_visible is null or c.public_visible <> 0) ) q where q.lat is not null and q.lng is not null and q.lat between #{south} and #{north} and q.lng between #{west} and #{east} order by q.id limit #{limit}

select a.id as activityId, a.topic_id as topicId, a.name as name, a.start_date as startDate, a.end_date as endDate, a.status as status, a.publish_status as publishStatus from cms_activity a where a.club_id = #{clubId} and a.del_flag = 0 and a.cancel_time is null and a.start_date < #{until} and (a.start_date >= #{since} or (a.end_date is not null and a.end_date >= #{since})) order by a.start_date asc, a.id asc limit #{limit}

select paid.activityId, paid.startDate, paid.memberId, case when corr.id is not null then corr.new_arrived when ck.arrived_at is not null or paid.verifiedCount > 0 or exists (select 1 from player_node_progress p where p.activity_id = paid.activityId and p.member_id = paid.memberId and p.status = 1 and p.del_flag = 0) then 1 else 0 end as arrived from ( select a.id as activityId, a.start_date as startDate, r.member_id as memberId, sum(r.verification_status = 1) as verifiedCount from cms_activity a join cms_registration r on r.owner_type = 2 and r.owner_id = a.id and r.payment_status = 2 and r.registration_status = 2 where a.club_id = #{clubId} and a.del_flag = 0 and a.cancel_time is null and a.start_date >= #{since} and a.start_date < #{until} group by a.id, a.start_date, r.member_id ) paid left join club_lead_checkin ck on ck.activity_id = paid.activityId and ck.member_id = paid.memberId left join club_event_attendance_correction corr on corr.id = ( select max(c2.id) from club_event_attendance_correction c2 where c2.activity_id = paid.activityId and c2.member_id = paid.memberId ) order by paid.startDate asc, paid.activityId asc, paid.memberId asc

select cm.member_id as memberId, cm.join_time as joinedAt from club_member cm join club c on c.id = cm.club_id and c.del_flag = 0 where cm.club_id = #{clubId} and cm.status = 1 and cm.del_flag = 0 and cm.member_id <> c.member_id
select count(*) from cms_topic t where t.club_id = #{clubId} and t.del_flag = 0 and ifnull(t.total_mileage, 0) > 0
